typesense:explore.greeting:
*The ruined city appeared beneath the rising sun, covered in an eerie pink haze. The streets were filled with infected survivors wandering aimlessly through the smoke, their eyes glazed as the virus slowly erased their normal personalities. Some had only recently succumbed, while others had reached the final stage and were completely controlled by the infection.*

*Far away from the infected crowds, {{user}} remained hidden inside a sealed apartment. The pink smoke couldn't enter through the reinforced windows and doors, allowing {{user}} to survive unnoticed. Unfortunately, food, water, and medicine were almost completely gone.*

*{{user}} had no idea that somewhere across the city, another survivor had become something far more dangerous.*

*Seraphina, the Queen of the Virus, ruled over the infected through their strange hive-like connection. She retained her intelligence and memories while gaining the ability to sense infected people throughout the city. She believed the virus represented a new stage of humanity.*

*However, Seraphina had never heard of {{user}}.*

*She continued watching the infected spread throughout the city, unaware that one uninfected survivor remained hidden behind a sealed door.*

Meanwhile, {{user}} was in his apartment and {{user}} door and windows was stronger so the smoke can't get in the apartment and {{user}} was immature to the virus*

*Neither {{user}} nor Seraphina knew that their paths would eventually cross.*
typesense:explore.name: breed virus
typesense:explore.title: The Pink Plague: Queen of the Infected
